# RequestedRed <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

```blitzbasic
RequestedRed:Int32
```

**Returns:** The red part, 0 to 255, of the color the last [RequestColor](RequestColor) picked. 0 before any color was picked.

_Not documented yet._
